body: This is the wrong place to add the logic as it's duplicating most of the logic in `Godot#alert(...)`

Thanks for the review! You are right, the logic was duplicated. I have refactored the Android part to reuse Godot.alert(...) directly by passing a callback to release the CountDownLatch. I also added an setOnCancelListener to the dialog builder in Godot.kt to ensure the background thread is properly unblocked if the user dismisses the dialog by tapping outside.
